import java.util.Calendar

data class WidgetDay(
    val dateNum: String,
    val dayOfWeekShort: String,
    val dayOfWeekFull: String,
    val monthName: String,
    val status: String,
    val time: String,
    val isToday: Boolean,
    val isCurrentMonth: Boolean
)

@Composable
private fun ColorProvider(day: Color, night: Color): ColorProvider {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val isNight = (context.resources.configuration.uiMode and Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_MASK) == Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_YES
    return ColorProvider(if (isNight) night else day)
}

class ScheduleWidgetReceiver : GlanceAppWidgetReceiver() {
    override val glanceAppWidget: GlanceAppWidget = ScheduleWidget()
}

class AlarmActionCallback : ActionCallback {
    override suspend fun onAction(
        context: Context,
        glanceId: GlanceId,
        parameters: ActionParameters
    ) {
        val isArming = parameters[ActionParameters.Key<Boolean>("isArming")] ?: false
        val store = parameters[ActionParameters.Key<String>("store")] ?: ""

        val msg = handleAlarmAction(storeName = store, isArming = isArming)
        android.widget.Toast.makeText(context, "Команда отправлена: $msg", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }
}

class ScheduleWidget : GlanceAppWidget() {

    override val sizeMode = SizeMode.Exact

    override suspend fun provideGlance(context: Context, id: GlanceId) {
        val cache = LocalCache()
        val userName = cache.getUserName() ?: ""
        val userStore = cache.getStoreName() ?: ""
        val userRole = cache.getUserRole() ?: ""
        val apiData = cache.getSchedule()
        val currentDay = getCurrentDay()

        val shortName = userName.split(" ").firstOrNull()?.uppercase() ?: ""

        // Примечание: требуется добавить метод getUserPosition() в LocalCache
        val userPosition = cache.getUserPosition() ?: ""
        val hasAlarmAccess = userPosition.contains("Директор", ignoreCase = true)

        val mySchedule = if (userRole == "user") {
            apiData?.results?.flatMap { it.schedule }?.find {
                it.name.uppercase().contains(shortName)
            }
        } else null

        val monthNamesGenitive = arrayOf(
            "янв", "фев", "мар", "апр", "мая", "июн",
            "июл", "авг", "сен", "окт", "ноя", "дек"
        )
        val monthNamesNominative = arrayOf(
            "Январь", "Февраль", "Март", "Апрель", "Май", "Июнь",
            "Июль", "Август", "Сентябрь", "Октябрь", "Ноябрь", "Декабрь"
        )
        val dayNamesShort = arrayOf("Пн", "Вт", "Ср", "Чт", "Пт", "Сб", "Вс")
        val dayNamesFull = arrayOf(
            "Понедельник", "Вторник", "Среда", "Четверг",
            "Пятница", "Суббота", "Воскресенье"
        )

        val cal = Calendar.getInstance()
        val currentMonthIndex = cal.get(Calendar.MONTH)
        val currentYear = cal.get(Calendar.YEAR)
        val currentMonthNameNom = "${monthNamesNominative[currentMonthIndex]} $currentYear"

        cal.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1)
        var firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK) - 1
        if (firstDayOfWeek == 0) firstDayOfWeek = 7
        val offset = firstDayOfWeek - 1

        cal.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, -offset)

        val grid = mutableListOf<WidgetDay>()
        for (i in 0 until 35) {
            val dNum = cal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH).toString()
            val mIndex = cal.get(Calendar.MONTH)
            val dOfWeekIndex = i % 7

            val apiDay = if (mIndex == currentMonthIndex) {
                mySchedule?.days?.find { it.date == dNum }
            } else null

            grid.add(
                WidgetDay(
                    dateNum = dNum,
                    dayOfWeekShort = dayNamesShort[dOfWeekIndex],
                    dayOfWeekFull = dayNamesFull[dOfWeekIndex],
                    monthName = monthNamesGenitive[mIndex],
                    status = apiDay?.status ?: "",
                    time = apiDay?.time ?: "",
                    isToday = (mIndex == currentMonthIndex && dNum == currentDay),
                    isCurrentMonth = (mIndex == currentMonthIndex)
                )
            )
            cal.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1)
        }

        provideContent {
            val size = LocalSize.current
            val height = size.height
            val width = size.width

            val widgetBg = ColorProvider(
                day = Color(0xF8FFFFFF),
                night = Color(0xF414151B)
            )

            val widgetBorder = ColorProvider(
                day = Color(0xFFDCE2ED),
                night = Color(0x33FFFFFF)
            )

            val intent = Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
                flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP
            }

            GlanceTheme {
                Box(
                    modifier = GlanceModifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .background(widgetBorder)
                        .cornerRadius(24.dp)
                        .padding(1.dp)
                ) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = GlanceModifier
                            .fillMaxSize()
                            .background(widgetBg)
                            .cornerRadius(23.dp)
                            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 14.dp)
                            .clickable(actionStartActivity(intent))
                    ) {
                        when {
                            height >= 240.dp -> {
                                LargeWidget(
                                    shortName,
                                    grid,
                                    currentMonthNameNom,
                                    hasAlarmAccess,
                                    userStore
                                )
                            }
                            width >= 260.dp -> {
                                MediumWidget(
                                    shortName,
                                    grid,
                                    currentMonthNameNom,
                                    hasAlarmAccess,
                                    userStore
                                )
                            }
                            else -> {
                                SmallWidget(
                                    shortName,
                                    grid,
                                    currentMonthNameNom,
                                    hasAlarmAccess,
                                    userStore
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Composable
    private fun SharedHeader(name: String, monthYear: String, hasAlarm: Boolean, store: String) {
        Row(
            modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text(
                        "WorkApp",
                        maxLines = 1,
                        style = TextStyle(
                            color = ColorProvider(
                                day = Color(0xFF1428A0),
                                night = Color(0xFF4C68EF)
                            ),
                            fontSize = 17.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    )
                    Text(
                        " | $name",
                        maxLines = 1,
                        style = TextStyle(
                            color = ColorProvider(
                                day = Color(0xFF111827),
                                night = Color.White
                            ),
                            fontSize = 18.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    )
                }
                Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(2.dp))
                Text(
                    monthYear,
                    style = TextStyle(
                        color = ColorProvider(
                            day = Color(0xFF6B7280),
                            night = Color(0xFF8B92A0)
                        ),
                        fontSize = 13.sp
                    )
                )
            }
            Spacer(GlanceModifier.defaultWeight())
            if (hasAlarm) AlarmButtons(store)
        }
    }

    @Composable
    private fun SmallWidget(
        name: String,
        grid: List<WidgetDay>,
        monthYear: String,
        hasAlarm: Boolean,
        store: String
    ) {
        val todayIndex = grid.indexOfFirst { it.isToday }
        val targetDay = if (todayIndex != -1) grid.getOrNull(todayIndex + 1) else null

        Column(modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            SharedHeader(name, monthYear, hasAlarm = false, store)

            Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.defaultWeight())

            val isShift = targetDay?.status?.uppercase()?.contains("СМЕН") == true
            val isWeekend = targetDay?.status?.uppercase()?.contains("ВЫХ") == true
            val isVac = targetDay?.status?.uppercase()?.contains("ОТП") == true

            val (statusText, textColor) = when {
                targetDay == null || (targetDay.status.isBlank() && targetDay.time.isBlank()) ->
                    "Смена не найдена" to ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF6B7280), night = Color(0xFF9CA3AF))
                isWeekend ->
                    "Выходной" to ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFFDC2626), night = Color(0xFFF87171))
                isVac ->
                    "Отпуск" to ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF0284C7), night = Color(0xFF60A5FA))
                isShift ->
                    targetDay.time.replace(" - ", "  -  ") to ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF1428A0), night = Color(0xFF829DFF))
                else ->
                    "Смена не найдена" to ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF6B7280), night = Color(0xFF9CA3AF))
            }

            Column(
                modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = if (targetDay != null) "Завтра, ${targetDay.dateNum} ${targetDay.monthName}" else "Завтра",
                    style = TextStyle(
                        color = ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF0F172A), night = Color.White),
                        fontSize = 19.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )
                )
                Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(14.dp))
                Box(
                    modifier = GlanceModifier
                        .background(
                            ColorProvider(
                                day = Color(0xFFE8EEFC),
                                night = Color(0xFF222634)
                            )
                        )
                        .cornerRadius(18.dp)
                        .padding(horizontal = 22.dp, vertical = 11.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = statusText,
                        style = TextStyle(
                            color = textColor,
                            fontSize = 21.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    )
                }
            }

            Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.defaultWeight())
        }
    }

    @Composable
    private fun MediumWidget(
        name: String,
        grid: List<WidgetDay>,
        monthYear: String,
        hasAlarm: Boolean,
        store: String
    ) {
        Column(modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            SharedHeader(name, monthYear, hasAlarm, store)

            Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.defaultWeight())

            val todayIndex = grid.indexOfFirst { it.isToday }.takeIf { it != -1 } ?: 0
            val weekStartIndex = (todayIndex / 7) * 7
            val weekDays = grid.subList(weekStartIndex, weekStartIndex + 7)

            Row(
                modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                weekDays.forEach { day ->
                    val isToday = day.isToday
                    val bgModifier = if (isToday) {
                        GlanceModifier
                            .background(
                                ColorProvider(
                                    day = Color(0xFFE8EEFC),
                                    night = Color(0xFF262D4A)
                                )
                            )
                            .cornerRadius(16.dp)
                    } else GlanceModifier

                    val dayOfWeekColor = if (isToday) {
                        ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF1428A0), night = Color(0xFF829DFF))
                    } else {
                        ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF475569), night = Color(0xFF8B92A0))
                    }

                    val dateNumColor = if (isToday) {
                        ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF1428A0), night = Color(0xFF829DFF))
                    } else {
                        ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF0F172A), night = Color.White)
                    }

                    Box(
                        modifier = GlanceModifier
                            .defaultWeight()
                            .then(bgModifier)
                            .padding(vertical = 6.dp, horizontal = 2.dp)
                    ) {
                        Column(
                            modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = day.dayOfWeekShort,
                                style = TextStyle(
                                    color = dayOfWeekColor,
                                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                                )
                            )
                            Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(2.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = day.dateNum,
                                style = TextStyle(
                                    color = dateNumColor,
                                    fontSize = 17.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                )
                            )
                            Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(3.dp))

                            val isShift = day.status.uppercase().contains("СМЕН")
                            val isWeekend = day.status.uppercase().contains("ВЫХ")
                            val isVac = day.status.uppercase().contains("ОТП")

                            if (isShift) {
                                val parts = day.time.replace(" ", "").split("-")
                                val start = parts.getOrNull(0) ?: ""
                                val end = parts.getOrNull(1) ?: ""
                                Text(
                                    start,
                                    style = TextStyle(
                                        color = ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF0F172A), night = Color.White),
                                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                    )
                                )
                                Text(
                                    "-",
                                    style = TextStyle(
                                        color = ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF94A3B8), night = Color(0xFF6B7280)),
                                        fontSize = 9.sp
                                    )
                                )
                                Text(
                                    end,
                                    style = TextStyle(
                                        color = ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF0F172A), night = Color.White),
                                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                    )
                                )
                            } else if (isWeekend) {
                                Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(6.dp))
                                Text(
                                    "Вых",
                                    style = TextStyle(
                                        color = ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFFDC2626), night = Color(0xFFF87171)),
                                        fontSize = 13.sp,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                                    )
                                )
                            } else if (isVac) {
                                Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(6.dp))
                                Text(
                                    "Отп",
                                    style = TextStyle(
                                        color = ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF0284C7), night = Color(0xFF60A5FA)),
                                        fontSize = 13.sp,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                                    )
                                )
                            } else {
                                Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(6.dp))
                                Text(
                                    "-",
                                    style = TextStyle(
                                        color = ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF6B7280), night = Color(0xFF8B92A0)),
                                        fontSize = 13.sp
                                    )
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.defaultWeight())
        }
    }

    @Composable
    private fun LargeWidget(
        name: String,
        grid: List<WidgetDay>,
        monthYear: String,
        hasAlarm: Boolean,
        store: String
    ) {
        Column(modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            SharedHeader(name, monthYear, hasAlarm, store)
            Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(14.dp))
            val weekNames = listOf("Пн", "Вт", "Ср", "Чт", "Пт", "Сб", "Вс")
            Row(modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                weekNames.forEach { dayName ->
                    Text(
                        text = dayName,
                        modifier = GlanceModifier.defaultWeight(),
                        style = TextStyle(
                            color = ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF475569), night = Color(0xFF8B92A0)),
                            fontSize = 14.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
                            textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
            Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(6.dp))

            val weeks = grid.chunked(7)
            weeks.forEach { week ->
                Row(modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxWidth().defaultWeight()) {
                    week.forEach { day ->
                        Box(
                            modifier = GlanceModifier.defaultWeight().fillMaxHeight().padding(2.dp)
                        ) {
                            LargeDayCell(day)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Composable
    private fun LargeDayCell(day: WidgetDay) {
        val isShift = day.status.uppercase().contains("СМЕН")
        val isWeekend = day.status.uppercase().contains("ВЫХ")
        val isVac = day.status.uppercase().contains("ОТП")

        val cellBg = when {
            day.isToday -> ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF1428A0), night = Color(0xFF364BC7))
            !day.isCurrentMonth -> ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFFEEF2F7), night = Color(0xFF171820))
            else -> ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFFE2E7F0), night = Color(0xFF20222B))
        }

        val dateColor = when {
            day.isToday -> ColorProvider(day = Color.White, night = Color.White)
            day.isCurrentMonth -> ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF0F172A), night = Color.White)
            else -> ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF94A3B8), night = Color(0xFF4B5563))
        }

        val timeColor = when {
            day.isToday -> ColorProvider(day = Color.White, night = Color.White)
            isShift -> ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF1428A0), night = Color(0xFF829DFF))
            isWeekend -> ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFFDC2626), night = Color(0xFFF87171))
            isVac -> ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF0284C7), night = Color(0xFF60A5FA))
            else -> ColorProvider(day = Color(0xFF94A3B8), night = Color(0xFF4B5563))
        }

        val contentText = when {
            isWeekend -> "Вых"
            isVac -> "Отп"
            isShift -> {
                val parts = day.time.replace(" ", "").split("-")
                val start = parts.getOrNull(0)?.replace(":00", "") ?: ""
                val end = parts.getOrNull(1)?.replace(":00", "") ?: ""
                "$start-$end"
            }
            else -> ""
        }

        Box(
            modifier = GlanceModifier.fillMaxSize().background(cellBg).cornerRadius(10.dp),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            Column(
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = day.dateNum,
                    style = TextStyle(
                        color = dateColor,
                        fontSize = 15.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )
                )
                if (contentText.isNotEmpty() && day.isCurrentMonth) {
                    Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.height(2.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = contentText,
                        style = TextStyle(
                            color = timeColor,
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Composable
    private fun AlarmButtons(store: String) {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Box(
                modifier = GlanceModifier
                    .size(36.dp)
                    .background(ColorProvider(day = Color(0x26EF4444), night = Color(0x33EF4444)))
                    .cornerRadius(50.dp)
                    .clickable(
                        actionRunCallback<AlarmActionCallback>(
                            actionParametersOf(
                                ActionParameters.Key<Boolean>("isArming") to true,
                                ActionParameters.Key<String>("store") to store
                            )
                        )
                    ),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Image(
                    provider = ImageProvider(R.drawable.ic_lock),
                    contentDescription = "Закрыть",
                    modifier = GlanceModifier.size(18.dp)
                )
            }
            Spacer(modifier = GlanceModifier.width(8.dp))
            Box(
                modifier = GlanceModifier
                    .size(36.dp)
                    .background(ColorProvider(day = Color(0x2622C55E), night = Color(0x3322C55E)))
                    .cornerRadius(50.dp)
                    .clickable(
                        actionRunCallback<AlarmActionCallback>(
                            actionParametersOf(
                                ActionParameters.Key<Boolean>("isArming") to false,
                                ActionParameters.Key<String>("store") to store
                            )
                        )
                    ),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Image(
                    provider = ImageProvider(R.drawable.ic_unlock),
                    contentDescription = "Открыть",
                    modifier = GlanceModifier.size(18.dp)
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

<file path="shared/src/androidMain/kotlin/org/project/onegalaxypersonalaccount/core/utils/DateUtils.android.kt">
package workapp.core.utils

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Calendar
import java.util.Locale

actual fun getCurrentRussianMonth(): String {
    val cal = Calendar.getInstance()
    val monthName = SimpleDateFormat("LLLL", Locale("ru")).format(cal.time)
    return monthName.replaceFirstChar { if (it.isLowerCase()) it.titlecase(Locale("ru")) else it.toString() }
}

actual fun getCurrentDay(): String {
    return Calendar.getInstance().get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH).toString()
}

actual fun getCurrentMonthNumber(): String {
    val month = Calendar.getInstance().get(Calendar.MONTH) + 1
    return if (month < 10) "0$month" else month.toString()
}

actual fun getCurrentMonthIndex(): Int {
    return Calendar.getInstance().get(Calendar.MONTH) + 1
}

actual fun getCurrentYear(): Int {
    return Calendar.getInstance().get(Calendar.YEAR)
}

actual fun getCurrentTimeMs(): Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
</file>

<file path="shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/project/onegalaxypersonalaccount/core/database/LocalCache.kt">
package workapp.core.database

import com.russhwolf.settings.Settings
import com.russhwolf.settings.set
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import workapp.core.network.MetaResponse
import workapp.core.network.ScheduleResponse
import workapp.core.network.UsefulLinkDto

class LocalCache {
    val settings = Settings()

    fun saveSession(
        role: String,
        name: String,
        storeName: String?,
        position: String = "",
        stores: List<String> = emptyList()
    ) {
        settings["is_logged_in"] = true
        settings["role"] = role
        settings["name"] = name
        settings["position"] = position
        if (storeName != null) {
            settings["store_name"] = storeName
        }
        if (stores.isNotEmpty()) {
            settings["assigned_stores"] = stores.joinToString(";")
        }
    }

    fun getUserPosition(): String = settings.getString("position", "")

    fun getAssignedStores(): List<String> {
        val raw = settings.getString("assigned_stores", "")
        return if (raw.isEmpty()) emptyList() else raw.split(";")
    }

    fun isLoggedIn(): Boolean = settings.getBoolean("is_logged_in", false)
    fun getUserRole(): String = settings.getString("role", "")
    fun getUserName(): String = settings.getString("name", "")
    fun getStoreName(): String = settings.getString("store_name", "")

    fun clearSession() {
        settings.clear()
    }

    fun saveSchedule(scheduleData: ScheduleResponse) {
        val jsonString = Json.encodeToString(scheduleData)
        settings["schedule_cache"] = jsonString
    }

    fun getSchedule(): ScheduleResponse? {
        val jsonString = settings.getString("schedule_cache", "")
        if (jsonString.isEmpty()) return null

        return try {
            Json.decodeFromString<ScheduleResponse>(jsonString)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun saveMeta(metaData: MetaResponse) {
        val jsonString = Json.encodeToString(metaData)
        settings["meta_cache"] = jsonString
    }

    fun getMeta(): MetaResponse? {
        val jsonString = settings.getString("meta_cache", "")
        if (jsonString.isEmpty()) return null
        return try {
            Json.decodeFromString<MetaResponse>(jsonString)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun saveUsefulLinks(links: List<UsefulLinkDto>) {
        val jsonString = Json.encodeToString(links)
        settings["useful_links_cache"] = jsonString
    }

    fun getUsefulLinks(): List<UsefulLinkDto> {
        val jsonString = settings.getString("useful_links_cache", "")
        if (jsonString.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return try {
            Json.decodeFromString<List<UsefulLinkDto>>(jsonString)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            emptyList()
        }
    }

    fun saveLastSelectedRegionalStore(storeName: String) {
        settings["last_regional_store"] = storeName
    }

    fun getLastSelectedRegionalStore(): String = settings.getString("last_regional_store", "")

    fun saveLastSyncTimestamp(timeMs: Long) {
        settings.putLong("last_sync_time", timeMs)
    }

    fun getLastSyncTimestamp(): Long {
        return settings.getLong("last_sync_time", 0L)
    }
}
</file>

package workapp.core.designsystem

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.border
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.composed
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.shadow
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

fun Modifier.liquidGlassCard(
    shape: RoundedCornerShape = AppShapes.innerCard,
    alpha: Float = 1.0f,
    elevation: Dp = 6.dp
): Modifier = composed {
    this
        .shadow(
            elevation = elevation,
            shape = shape,
            clip = false,
            spotColor = Color(0x24000000),
            ambientColor = Color(0x10000000)
        )
        .clip(shape)
        .background(CustomColors.surface)
        .border(
            width = 1.dp,
            color = CustomColors.surfaceBorder,
            shape = shape
        )
}

<file path="shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/project/onegalaxypersonalaccount/core/designsystem/Navigation.kt">
package workapp.core.designsystem

import androidx.compose.animation.core.Spring
import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateDpAsState
import androidx.compose.animation.core.spring
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.border
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.interaction.MutableInteractionSource
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxHeight
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.height
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.navigationBarsPadding
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.offset
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.size
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.width
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.CircleShape
import androidx.compose.material3.Icon
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.shadow
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.vector.ImageVector
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

data class NavItem(val title: String, val icon: ImageVector)

@Composable
fun AnimatedBottomNavBar(
    selectedItem: Int,
    onItemSelected: (Int) -> Unit,
    items: List<NavItem>,
    accentColor: Color = CustomColors.primaryAccent,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val itemWidth = 72.dp
    val totalWidth = itemWidth * items.size
    val indicatorSize = 48.dp

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .navigationBarsPadding(),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.BottomCenter
    ) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .width(totalWidth)
                .height(60.dp)
                .shadow(
                    elevation = 12.dp,
                    shape = AppShapes.pill,
                    spotColor = Color(0x38000000),
                    ambientColor = Color(0x1A000000)
                )
                .clip(AppShapes.pill)
                .background(CustomColors.surface)
                .border(
                    width = 1.dp,
                    color = CustomColors.surfaceBorder,
                    shape = AppShapes.pill
                )
        ) {
            val targetOffset = itemWidth * selectedItem + (itemWidth - indicatorSize) / 2
            val indicatorOffset by animateDpAsState(
                targetValue = targetOffset,
                animationSpec = spring(
                    dampingRatio = Spring.DampingRatioNoBouncy,
                    stiffness = Spring.StiffnessMedium
                ),
                label = "indicatorOffset"
            )

            // Скользящий круг
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .offset(x = indicatorOffset)
                    .size(indicatorSize)
                    .align(Alignment.CenterStart)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(accentColor)
            )

            // Иконки
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                items.forEachIndexed { index, item ->
                    val isSelected = selectedItem == index
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .width(itemWidth)
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .clickable(
                                interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                                indication = null,
                                onClick = { onItemSelected(index) }
                            ),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = item.icon,
                            contentDescription = item.title,
                            tint = if (isSelected) Color.White else CustomColors.textSecondary,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/project/onegalaxypersonalaccount/core/designsystem/Theme.kt">
package workapp.core.designsystem

import androidx.compose.foundation.isSystemInDarkTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.darkColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.lightColorScheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.CompositionLocalProvider

@Composable
fun AppTheme(
    useDarkTheme: Boolean = isSystemInDarkTheme(),
    content: @Composable () -> Unit
) {
    val customColors = if (useDarkTheme) DarkCustomColorsPalette else LightCustomColorsPalette

    val materialColors = if (useDarkTheme) {
        darkColorScheme(
            primary = customColors.primaryAccent,
            background = customColors.background,
            surface = customColors.surface,
            onBackground = customColors.textPrimary,
            onSurface = customColors.textPrimary
        )
    } else {
        lightColorScheme(
            primary = customColors.primaryAccent,
            background = customColors.background,
            surface = customColors.surface,
            onBackground = customColors.textPrimary,
            onSurface = customColors.textPrimary
        )
    }

    CompositionLocalProvider(LocalCustomColors provides customColors) {
        MaterialTheme(
            colorScheme = materialColors,
            typography = AppTypography,
            content = content
        )
    }
}
</file>

<file path="shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/project/onegalaxypersonalaccount/core/network/ApiClient.kt">
package workapp.core.network

import io.ktor.client.HttpClient
import io.ktor.client.call.body
import io.ktor.client.plugins.contentnegotiation.ContentNegotiation
import io.ktor.client.request.get
import io.ktor.client.request.post
import io.ktor.client.request.setBody
import io.ktor.client.statement.HttpResponse
import io.ktor.http.ContentType
import io.ktor.http.HttpHeaders
import io.ktor.http.HttpStatusCode
import io.ktor.http.content.TextContent
import io.ktor.serialization.kotlinx.json.json
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

class ApiClient {
    private val scriptUrl = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyiQFKo8MZGs12oocgY2x_D58sF-h0rESjBPknXr0eNIZsYHf6s7F-hRxgLAcyuHoMU/exec"

    private val jsonFormatter = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        prettyPrint = true
        isLenient = true
    }

    private val client = HttpClient {
        install(ContentNegotiation) {
            json(jsonFormatter)
        }
    }

    suspend fun getUsefulLinks(): Result<List<UsefulLinkDto>> {
        return try {
            val requestBody = jsonFormatter.encodeToString(
                ApiRequest(action = "get_links")
            )

            val initialResponse: HttpResponse = client.post(scriptUrl) {
                setBody(TextContent(requestBody, ContentType.Text.Plain))
            }

            val response: UsefulLinksResponse = handleResponse(initialResponse)
            if (response.success) {
                Result.success(response.links)
            } else {
                Result.failure(Exception(response.error ?: "Ошибка загрузки ссылок"))
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }

    suspend fun getMeta(monthSheet: String): MetaResponse {
        return try {
            val requestBody = jsonFormatter.encodeToString(
                MetaRequest(action = "get_meta", monthSheet = monthSheet)
            )

            val initialResponse: HttpResponse = client.post(scriptUrl) {
                setBody(TextContent(requestBody, ContentType.Text.Plain))
            }

            handleResponse(initialResponse)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            MetaResponse(success = false, error = "Ошибка сети: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    suspend fun login(accessLevel: String, storeName: String, name: String, password: String): AuthResponse {
        return try {
            val requestBody = jsonFormatter.encodeToString(
                ApiRequest(
                    action = "login",
                    accessLevel = accessLevel,
                    storeName = storeName,
                    name = name,
                    password = password
                )
            )

            val initialResponse: HttpResponse = client.post(scriptUrl) {
                setBody(TextContent(requestBody, ContentType.Text.Plain))
            }

            handleResponse(initialResponse)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            AuthResponse(success = false, error = "Ошибка сети: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    suspend fun getSchedule(storeName: String, employeeName: String, monthSheet: String): ScheduleResponse {
        return try {
            val requestBody = jsonFormatter.encodeToString(
                ApiRequest(
                    action = "get_schedule",
                    storeName = storeName,
                    employeeName = employeeName,
                    monthSheet = monthSheet
                )
            )

            val initialResponse: HttpResponse = client.post(scriptUrl) {
                setBody(TextContent(requestBody, ContentType.Text.Plain))
            }

            handleResponse(initialResponse)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            ScheduleResponse(success = false, error = "Ошибка сети: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    private suspend inline fun <reified T> handleResponse(initialResponse: HttpResponse): T {
        if (initialResponse.status == HttpStatusCode.Found || initialResponse.status == HttpStatusCode.MovedPermanently) {
            val redirectUrl = initialResponse.headers[HttpHeaders.Location]
            if (redirectUrl != null) {
                val finalResponse: HttpResponse = client.get(redirectUrl)
                return finalResponse.body()
            }
        }

        return initialResponse.body()
    }

    suspend fun searchOffice(query: String): OfficeSearchResponse {
        return try {
            val requestBody = jsonFormatter.encodeToString(
                ApiRequest(action = "search_office", query = query)
            )

            val initialResponse: HttpResponse = client.post(scriptUrl) {
                setBody(TextContent(requestBody, ContentType.Text.Plain))
            }

            handleResponse(initialResponse)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            OfficeSearchResponse(success = false, error = "Ошибка сети: ${e.message}")
        }
    }
}

package workapp.core.network

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
data class ApiRequest(
    val action: String,
    val monthSheet: String = "",
    val accessLevel: String = "",
    val storeName: String = "",
    val login: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val name: String = "",
    val employeeName: String = "",
    val query: String = ""
)

@Serializable
data class UsefulLinkDto(
    val title: String,
    val description: String,
    val url: String,
    val type: String
)

@Serializable
data class UsefulLinksResponse(
    val success: Boolean,
    val links: List<UsefulLinkDto> = emptyList(),
    val error: String? = null
)

@Serializable
data class MetaResponse(
    val success: Boolean,
    val stores: Map<String, List<String>> = emptyMap(),
    val admins: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val regionals: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val availableMonths: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val error: String? = null
)

@Serializable
data class MetaData(
    val admins: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val stores: Map<String, List<String>> = emptyMap()
)

@Serializable
data class AuthResponse(
    val success: Boolean,
    val role: String? = null,
    val name: String? = null,
    val store: String? = null,
    val position: String? = null,
    val stores: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val error: String? = null
)

@Serializable
data class ScheduleResponse(
    val success: Boolean,
    val actual_version: String? = null,
    val results: List<StoreScheduleResult> = emptyList(),
    val error: String? = null
)

@Serializable
data class StoreScheduleResult(
    val storeName: String? = null,
    val contacts: StoreContacts? = null,
    val schedule: List<EmployeeSchedule> = emptyList(),
    val salary: SalaryData? = null
)

@Serializable
data class EmployeeSchedule(
    val name: String,
    val days: List<WorkDay>
)

@Serializable
data class WorkDay(
    val date: String,
    val status: String,
    val time: String
)

@Serializable
data class SalaryData(
    val cash: String,
    val card: String
)

@Serializable
data class MetaRequest(
    val action: String,
    val monthSheet: String
)

@Serializable
data class StoreContacts(
    val internal: String = "",
    val phone: String = "",
    val email: String = ""
)

@Serializable
data class OfficeSearchResponse(
    val success: Boolean,
    val results: List<OfficeEmployee> = emptyList(),
    val error: String? = null
)

@Serializable
data class OfficeEmployee(
    val name: String,
    val position: String,
    val phone: String,
    val internal: String,
    val email: String,
    val questions: String
)

package workapp.core.utils

expect fun getCurrentRussianMonth(): String
expect fun getCurrentDay(): String
expect fun getCurrentMonthNumber(): String
expect fun getCurrentMonthIndex(): Int
expect fun getCurrentYear(): Int

expect fun getCurrentTimeMs(): Long

fun getRussianDayOfWeek(day: Int, month: Int, year: Int): String {
    val t = intArrayOf(0, 3, 2, 5, 0, 3, 5, 1, 4, 6, 2, 4)
    var y = year
    if (month < 3) y -= 1
    val dow = (y + y / 4 - y / 100 + y / 400 + t[month - 1] + day) % 7
    return when (dow) {
        1 -> "Пн"
        2 -> "Вт"
        3 -> "Ср"
        4 -> "Чт"
        5 -> "Пт"
        6 -> "Сб"
        0 -> "Вс"
        else -> ""
    }
}

@Composable
fun AdminDashboard(
    screenModel: MainScreenModel,
    navigator: Navigator
) {
    val pagerState = rememberPagerState(initialPage = 1, pageCount = { 2 })
    val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(CustomColors.background)
    ) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .statusBarsPadding()
                .clip(RectangleShape)
        ) {
            HorizontalPager(
                state = pagerState,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                beyondViewportPageCount = 1
            ) { page ->
                when (page) {
                    0 -> UsefulLinksScreen(navigator)
                    1 -> AdminHomeScreen(screenModel, navigator)
                }
            }
        }

        AnimatedBottomNavBar(
            selectedItem = pagerState.currentPage,
            onItemSelected = { index ->
                coroutineScope.launch {
                    pagerState.animateScrollToPage(index)
                }
            },
            items = listOf(
                NavItem("Инфо", Icons.Default.LocalOffer),
                NavItem("Главная", Icons.Default.Home)
            ),
            accentColor = CustomColors.adminAccent,
            modifier = Modifier
                .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                .padding(bottom = 16.dp)
        )
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun AdminHomeScreen(
    screenModel: MainScreenModel,
    navigator: Navigator
) {
    val state by screenModel.state.collectAsState()
    var searchQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
    var isSearchExpanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val searchFocusRequester = remember { FocusRequester() }

    LaunchedEffect(isSearchExpanded) {
        if (isSearchExpanded) {
            searchFocusRequester.requestFocus()
        }
    }

    Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.TopCenter) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                .padding(horizontal = 16.dp)
                .padding(top = 16.dp),
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
        ) {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .widthIn(max = 1200.dp)
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = Icons.Default.LocationOn,
                            contentDescription = "Локация",
                            tint = CustomColors.adminAccent,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                        )
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = "1Galaxy | Офис",
                            color = CustomColors.textPrimary,
                            fontSize = 18.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
                        )
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                        TextButton(
                            onClick = {
                                val cache = LocalCache()
                                cache.clearSession()
                                navigator.replaceAll(AuthScreen())
                            },
                            contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)
                        ) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .height(36.dp)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(50))
                                    .background(CustomColors.surface.copy(alpha = 0.9f))
                                    .border(
                                        1.dp,
                                        CustomColors.surfaceBorder.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
                                        RoundedCornerShape(50)
                                    )
                                    .clickable {
                                        val cache = LocalCache()
                                        cache.clearSession()
                                        navigator.replaceAll(AuthScreen())
                                    }
                                    .padding(horizontal = 16.dp),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = "Выйти",
                                    color = CustomColors.primaryAccent,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                    fontSize = 14.sp
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))

                    Row(
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    ) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .size(64.dp)
                                .clip(CircleShape)
                                .background(CustomColors.surface.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
                                .border(
                                    width = 1.dp,
                                    brush = Brush.linearGradient(
                                        colors = listOf(
                                            Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.3f),
                                            CustomColors.adminAccent.copy(alpha = 0.5f)
                                        )
                                    ),
                                    shape = CircleShape
                                ),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            val initials = screenModel.userName.split(" ")
                                .take(2)
                                .joinToString("") { it.take(1) }
                                .uppercase()

                            Text(
                                text = initials,
                                color = CustomColors.adminAccent,
                                fontSize = 22.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
                            )
                        }

                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))

                        Column {
                            Text(
                                text = screenModel.userName,
                                color = CustomColors.textPrimary,
                                fontSize = 22.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                            )
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = screenModel.userPosition,
                                color = CustomColors.textSecondary,
                                fontSize = 14.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                            )
                        }
                    }

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(32.dp))

                    SearchModeToggle(
                        currentMode = state.searchMode,
                        onModeSelected = { screenModel.setSearchMode(it) }
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(32.dp))

                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = "НЕДАВНИЕ ЗАПРОСЫ",
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                            color = CustomColors.textSecondary
                        )
                        if (state.recentSearches.isNotEmpty()) {
                            TextButton(
                                onClick = { screenModel.clearRecentSearches() },
                                contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp),
                                modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp)
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    "Очистить",
                                    color = CustomColors.adminAccent,
                                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
                    ) {
                        if (state.recentSearches.isEmpty()) {
                            Text(
                                "История поиска пуста",
                                color = CustomColors.textSecondary,
                                fontSize = 14.sp
                            )
                        } else {
                            state.recentSearches.forEach { searchEntry ->
                                val parts = searchEntry.split("|")
                                val query = parts.getOrElse(0) { searchEntry }
                                val count = parts.getOrElse(1) { "-" }
                                val modeStr = parts.getOrElse(2) { "RETAIL" }

                                RecentStoreCard(
                                    id = if (modeStr == "OFFICE") "Офис" else "Розница",
                                    name = query,
                                    address = "Нажмите для повтора",
                                    empCount = count,
                                    showCount = modeStr == "RETAIL",
                                    onClick = {
                                        searchQuery = ""
                                        screenModel.setSearchMode(if (modeStr == "OFFICE") SearchMode.OFFICE else SearchMode.RETAIL)
                                        screenModel.searchSchedule(query)
                                    }
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(32.dp))

                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        if (state.searchResult != null) {
                            IconButton(
                                onClick = { screenModel.refreshSchedule() },
                                modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)
                            ) {
                                Icon(
                                    imageVector = Icons.Default.Refresh,
                                    contentDescription = "Обновить",
                                    tint = CustomColors.adminAccent
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

                    when {
                        state.isLoading && state.hasSearched -> {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(200.dp),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                CircularProgressIndicator(color = CustomColors.primaryAccent)
                            }
                        }

                        state.error != null -> {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(100.dp),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Text(text = state.error!!, color = Color(0xFFEF9A9A))
                            }
                        }

                        state.searchMode == SearchMode.RETAIL && state.searchResult != null -> {
                            state.searchResult!!.results.forEach { result ->
                                ScheduleCard(
                                    apiSchedule = result.schedule,
                                    storeTitle = result.storeName,
                                    contacts = result.contacts,
                                    currentDay = screenModel.currentDay,
                                    onClose = { screenModel.clearSearchResults() }
                                )
                                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
                            }
                        }
                        state.searchMode == SearchMode.OFFICE && state.officeSearchResult != null -> {
                            state.officeSearchResult!!.results.forEach { emp ->
                                OfficeEmployeeCard(
                                    employee = emp,
                                    onClose = { screenModel.clearSearchResults() }
                                )
                            }
                        }

                        !state.hasSearched -> {
                            Text(
                                text = if (state.searchMode == SearchMode.RETAIL) "ВСЕ МАГАЗИНЫ" else "ВЕСЬ ОФИС",
                                fontSize = 12.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                                color = CustomColors.textSecondary,
                                modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 12.dp)
                            )

                            val meta = state.metaData
                            if (meta != null) {
                                val list = if (state.searchMode == SearchMode.RETAIL) {
                                    meta.stores.keys.toList().sorted()
                                } else {
                                    meta.admins.sorted()
                                }

                                list.forEach { itemName ->
                                    CompactDirectoryCard(
                                        title = itemName,
                                        onClick = {
                                            searchQuery = ""
                                            screenModel.searchSchedule(itemName)
                                            focusManager.clearFocus()
                                        }
                                    )
                                }
                            } else {
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(100.dp),
                                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        "Введите запрос для поиска",
                                        color = CustomColors.textSecondary
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(170.dp))
                }
            }
        }

        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .align(Alignment.BottomEnd)
                .padding(horizontal = 16.dp)
                .padding(bottom = 128.dp)
                .widthIn(max = 500.dp)
                .then(if (isSearchExpanded) Modifier.fillMaxWidth() else Modifier)
                .animateContentSize(
                    animationSpec = spring(
                        dampingRatio = Spring.DampingRatioLowBouncy,
                        stiffness = Spring.StiffnessMediumLow
                    )
                ),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterEnd
        ) {
            if (isSearchExpanded) {
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = searchQuery,
                    onValueChange = { searchQuery = it },
                    placeholder = {
                        Text(
                            "Поиск сотрудника или магазина...",
                            color = CustomColors.textSecondary.copy(alpha = 0.6f)
                        )
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .focusRequester(searchFocusRequester),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(50),
                    colors = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
                        focusedContainerColor = CustomColors.surface.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                        unfocusedContainerColor = CustomColors.surface.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                        unfocusedBorderColor = CustomColors.surfaceBorder.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
                        focusedBorderColor = CustomColors.primaryAccent,
                        unfocusedTextColor = CustomColors.textPrimary,
                        focusedTextColor = CustomColors.textPrimary
                    ),
                    singleLine = true,
                    trailingIcon = {
                        IconButton(onClick = {
                            screenModel.searchSchedule(searchQuery)
                            searchQuery = ""
                            focusManager.clearFocus()
                            isSearchExpanded = false
                        }) {
                            Icon(
                                Icons.Default.Search,
                                contentDescription = "Поиск",
                                tint = CustomColors.primaryAccent
                            )
                        }
                    },
                    keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Search),
                    keyboardActions = KeyboardActions(
                        onSearch = {
                            screenModel.searchSchedule(searchQuery)
                            searchQuery = ""
                            focusManager.clearFocus()
                            isSearchExpanded = false
                        }
                    )
                )
            } else {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(64.dp)
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(CustomColors.surface.copy(alpha = 0.85f))
                        .border(1.dp, CustomColors.surfaceBorder.copy(alpha = 0.5f), CircleShape)
                        .clickable { isSearchExpanded = true },
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Default.Search,
                        contentDescription = "Открыть поиск",
                        tint = CustomColors.primaryAccent,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp)
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun RecentStoreCard(
    id: String,
    name: String,
    address: String,
    empCount: String,
    showCount: Boolean = true,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .width(200.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .clickable { onClick() }
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = id,
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = CustomColors.textSecondary
                )
            }
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
            Text(
                text = name,
                fontSize = 18.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                color = CustomColors.textPrimary
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
            Text(
                text = address,
                fontSize = 12.sp,
                color = CustomColors.textSecondary
            )

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
            if (showCount) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Default.People,
                        contentDescription = "Сотрудники",
                        tint = CustomColors.adminAccent,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = empCount,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        color = CustomColors.textPrimary
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package workapp.feature.auth

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.size
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.widthIn
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape

import androidx.compose.foundation.text.KeyboardOptions
